sloka: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकुर्वन् दुर्हृद: साधु निर्द्दहन् ।सुहृदस्तर्पयन् कामैस्त्वमेवात्रानुशाधि माम् ॥ २.१०६.२८॥
transliteration: ṛṇāni trīṇyapākurvan durhṛda: sādhu nirddahan ।suhṛdastarpayan kāmaistvamevātrānuśādhi mām ॥ 2.106.28॥

translations.english: Discharging completely the three debts, to gods, to ancestors and to sages, subduing your enemies and gratifying your friends, you alone (have the right) to dictate me.
